note: Private campground on Pine Lake in Forest County, with a boat launch, guest pier and a swimming pond. Several nightly 30- and 50-amp sites, pull-throughs among them, line the shore road. Tent sites, two cabins and a rental camper are also on site. About half the sites are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator site, rates, seasonal page, 2026 map, site photo, Google and imagery read. Lakefront confirmed on sites 4 and 7-13 (nightly). Fees $35-50 confirmed (manual), booking roverpass -> operator (Firefly), season/hookups confirmed with sewer false, facilities and a military discount added. About 41 of 83 sites seasonal; price gate passes.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront KEPT. On the 2026 map the shore row is site 4 (back-in 50/30), 7-9 (pull-through 50/30), 10-11 (pull-through 30/20), 12 (back-in 50/30), 12A and 13 (back-in 30/20) - all nightly types; 5, 6 and 14 in the same row are seasonal. Imagery: that row is open grass about 15-30 m from the Pine Lake shore with only the campground's shore road between, centred about 45.6955,-88.9834; the operator's site 7 photo shows an open pad looking straight onto the lake. Lakeside sites $45-50.

LONG-STAY: the 2026 map marks 41 seasonal sites (2, 3, 5, 6, 14-17, 22-40, 42, 46-48, 53-58, 60, 61, 61A, 61B; 42 shaded slightly differently) against 42 nightly (22 RV sites with water, one 30/20 with no water, six 20-amp, 2 primitive and 12 meadow primitive). Nightly share about half - passes all five tests (posted nightly rates, Firefly booking, 2+ nightly). Note says so.
PRICE GATE (private): passes - ordinary RV sites $42-45 (regular) and lakeside $45-50; no Good Sam Park; no gateway needed.
